meta.title: ANATOMICA respiratory system inventory — Milestone 10

meta.counting_convention: One record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left as separate records, mirroring the skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular and nervous modules); one record for an un-sided class modelled jointly; a lateralised concept whose side-stripped class does not exist in the release is one record keyed on the concept itself. The nose and lungs are records keyed on their PART-OF-only organ concepts; the lobes, bronchopulmonary segments and named nose parts existing only in PART-OF are records keyed on PART-OF concepts; airway, larynx and nasal-cartilage structures are records keyed on IS-A concepts. Muscles, the diaphragm, segmental pulmonary vessels, the nasal conchae, structural roots, generic part classes, aggregate/composition concepts, wall/region classes and the pulmopleural compartments are censused with cross-references, not recorded here.

totalsegmentator_overlap.note: of the 104 TotalSegmentator v1 labels (Milestone 3 census), exactly six are respiratory: the trachea and the five lung lobes. TS v1 has no bronchopulmonary segment, bronchus, larynx, nose, pharynx or pleura label, so it adds no coverage below the lobe level.
